description.en: Official runtime and operator docs; stable v0.17.7–v0.18.3 adds safer fall handling, weak-link camera adaptation, beta-camera calibration, pad reconnection, faster boot checks, opt-in vetbook sharing and anonymous telemetry with an opt-out.
description.zh: 官方运行时与操作文档；稳定版 v0.17.7–v0.18.3 新增更安全的跌倒处理、弱网摄像头自适应、beta 摄像头标定、手柄重连、加快启动检查、可选健康档案分享，以及可退出的匿名遥测。

description.en: Official production image; v1.1.0 ships the gamepad and NFC daemons, preserves Bluetooth bonds across slot updates, improves install filtering and verifies the V1.0 face-board LED mapping; the new factory flashing guide is not yet end-to-end board-validated.
description.zh: 官方生产镜像；v1.1.0 随镜像提供手柄与 NFC 守护进程，在分区切换更新后保留蓝牙配对，改进可安装版本筛选，并逐灯验证 V1.0 面板映射；新工厂刷写指南尚未在板卡上完整走通。

description.en: Official CUDA training workspace with v8 lineage and author-reported hardware validation; it now supports opt-in Hub bundles containing full checkpoints, provenance and distillation teachers for resuming or warm-starting training.
description.zh: 官方 CUDA 训练工程，含 v8 谱系与作者报告的真机验证；现支持选择性发布 Hub 训练包，包含完整检查点、来源记录和蒸馏教师，可用于续训或热启动。

description.en: Try the hosted simulator before choosing a local setup.
description.zh: 先在线体验仿真，再决定是否搭建本地环境。

description.en: Official v8 ONNX set; authors report real-robot validation for smoother, more reliable get-up and tracked yaw commands, building on v7 standing roll and pitch control.
description.zh: 官方 v8 ONNX 策略集；作者报告已在真机验证更平顺可靠的起身和偏航指令跟踪，并延续 v7 的站立横滚与俯仰控制。

description.en: Find the relevant operator or developer guide.
description.zh: 按操作与开发需求查找上游文档。

description.en: Run the real runtime daemons against MuJoCo bodies; physical buses and device drivers remain outside the simulation.
description.zh: 用真实运行时守护进程驱动 MuJoCo 机体；物理总线和设备驱动不在仿真范围内。

description.en: Track stable daemon releases separately from signed development builds.
description.zh: 跟踪稳定版 daemon，并与签名开发构建区分。

description.en: Community guide spanning simulation, training and DIY research; keep its source labels and unresolved hardware questions in view.
description.zh: 覆盖仿真、训练与复刻研究的双语社区指南；阅读时保留对来源标签和未决硬件问题的关注。

description.en: Look up commands for the installed runtime version.
description.zh: 查阅对应运行时版本的操作命令。

description.en: Check policy metadata and compatibility requirements.
description.zh: 核对策略元数据与兼容性要求。

description.en: Official reproducible policy competition with fixed server-side courses and downloadable entries; v0.7.0 adds Tug of War and the six-metre red-light/green-light Sock Heist challenge.
description.zh: 官方可复现策略竞赛平台，使用固定服务端赛道并支持下载参赛策略；v0.7.0 新增拔河与六米红绿灯玩法 Sock Heist。

resources.name: Microduck challenges
resources.environment: Python 3.12 / CUDA or Hugging Face Jobs

description.en: Official public training folders and workshop for six Arena events, including Tug of War and Sock Heist, with checkpoint evaluation and publish-to-Arena workflows; scores are simulation evidence only.
description.zh: 官方公开的六项 Arena 赛事训练目录与工作坊，新增拔河与 Sock Heist，支持检查点评测及发布到 Arena；成绩仅属于仿真证据。

description.en: Apple Silicon and CPU training lab with browser worlds, multi-duck soccer and tidying behaviors; all reviewed results remain simulation-only.
description.zh: 面向 Apple Silicon 与 CPU 的训练实验室，含浏览器世界、多鸭足球和整理行为；本次核验结果仍仅限仿真。

description.en: Explore a portable PyTorch implementation; check backend limitations first.
description.zh: 探索 PyTorch 移植方案；先阅读各计算后端的限制。

description.en: An AMD-oriented training alternative; follow its tested configuration.
description.zh: 面向 AMD 的训练替代方案；使用项目列出的已测试配置。

description.en: Task-port research. The reviewed README reports unsuccessful locomotion; do not select it as a ready walking policy.
description.zh: 任务移植研究。核验时 README 明示行走尚未成功，不应作为现成行走策略。

description.en: ROS 2 Jazzy viewer and Isaac Sim/Lab tutorials now pin the official v7 policies; the converted USD and GPU playback still await revalidation, and there is no physical driver.
description.zh: ROS 2 Jazzy 查看器与 Isaac Sim/Lab 教程现已固定官方 v7 策略；转换后的 USD 与 GPU 回放仍待复验，且不含真机驱动。

description.en: Community MuJoCo and ONNX simulator with touch controls and policy import; it does not control physical hardware.
description.zh: 支持触控与策略导入的社区 MuJoCo 和 ONNX 仿真器；不控制实体硬件。

description.en: Reproducible simulations cover chimney climbing, a raised-platform long jump and a backflip with published policies; hardware remains untested and the backflip carries a breakage warning.
description.zh: 可复现仿真涵盖烟囱攀爬、高台长跳与后空翻并发布策略；真机仍未测试，后空翻明确提示可能损坏机器人。

description.en: Consumer-GPU training journal with released ONNX policies, patches, raw multi-seed evaluation data and checksums; its v0.2 speed and recovery results are author-reported simulations without hardware validation.
description.zh: 面向消费级 GPU 的训练记录，已发布 ONNX 策略、补丁、多随机种子原始评测数据与校验和；v0.2 的速度和恢复结果为作者报告的仿真数据，尚无真机验证。

description.en: Zero-dependency Swift implementation of the policy, observation, kinematics and RPC contracts; author reports 347 offline tests but no hardware validation.
description.zh: 以零依赖 Swift 实现策略、观测、运动学与 RPC 契约；作者报告 347 项离线测试，但尚无真机验证。

description.en: A development interface joining runtime and simulation; requires sibling repositories.
description.zh: 连接运行时与仿真的开发界面；需配套同级仓库。

description.en: Agent interface with mock and simulation paths. Its README states real-device transports have only fake-daemon validation.
description.zh: 提供 mock 与仿真路径的 Agent 接口；README 说明真机传输仅经过伪守护进程验证。

description.en: Goal-directed robot CLI, browser UI and MCP bridge with mock and MuJoCo paths; v0.29.1 adds vision, head tracking and simulated room exploration, while the maintainer still reports no Microduck hardware run.
description.zh: 面向目标任务的机器人 CLI、浏览器界面与 MCP 桥接，支持 mock 和 MuJoCo；v0.29.1 已加入视觉、头部跟踪与仿真房间探索，但维护者仍说明尚无 Microduck 真机运行。

description.en: Chinese assembly and setup guide with author-published hardware clips; its configuration differs from the official product.
description.zh: 中文装机与部署教程，作者提供实物视频；配置与官方产品不同。

resources.name: DuckBuddy
resources.environment: DIY / Orange Pi Zero 3W / Feetech HL-2915

description.en: Open hardware and software fork with published boards, firmware, training code and an author hardware demo of offline voice-triggered action sequences; the HL-2915 build is in daily use, while HD-1910, on-device VLM and localization remain unfinished.
description.zh: 开放硬件与软件分支，公开板卡、固件、训练代码及作者实机离线语音连续动作演示；HL-2915 版本已日常使用，HD-1910、端侧 VLM 与定位仍未完成。

description.en: Parametric external-compute mount with printable CAD and reproducible payload-policy studies; fit, strength and control results remain simulation-only.
description.zh: 面向外置算力的参数化挂载方案，提供可打印 CAD 与可复现的载荷策略研究；适配、强度和控制结果仍仅限仿真。

description.en: HD-1910 build stack with published HAT and IMU files, print set, firmware, control and training consoles, a tested R1 system image and author hardware videos; calibration is required and original additions are non-commercial.
description.zh: HD-1910 构建栈，公开 HAT 与 IMU 文件、打印件、固件、机器人及训练中控、已刷卡测试的 R1 镜像和作者实机视频；仍需逐机标定，原创新增部分限非商业使用。

description.en: The HD-1910 build reports sustained walking and now ships signed browser updates, local sit/stand voice control, model management and diagnostics; the 2026-10-31 driver, new image combinations and Qinmo IMU path still have explicit hardware-acceptance gaps.
description.zh: HD-1910 复刻已报告持续行走，并提供签名网页更新、本地坐站语音、模型管理与诊断；2026-10-31 手柄驱动、新镜像组合及秦墨 IMU 路线仍有明确的实物验收缺口。

description.en: Arduino Uno Q adaptation with author hardware demos; V1.1 publishes manufacturing files plus reverse-connection and servo-stall test videos, but omits the V1.1 PCB source and compatibility notes, and older boards still require the documented wiring check.
description.zh: 基于 Arduino Uno Q 且有作者实机演示；V1.1 已公开生产文件及反接、堵转测试视频，但缺少 V1.1 PCB 源文件与兼容说明，旧板仍须按文档核对接线。

description.en: Completed community replica with author-published hardware footage and packaged BOM, print and board files; review the non-commercial model terms.
description.zh: 已完成的社区复刻，提供作者实机演示、BOM、打印与板件资料；使用前核对模型的非商业条款。
